normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front - Complimentary beach service (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) provided from March 1- October 31 - Private, gulf-front pool and sitting spa **Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day** The pool and spa are heated together. - Great location on 30A- 2 blocks away from Surfing Deer & Seagrove Village Market restaurants- Spectacular views throughout the home- 3 master suites (2 with Gulf views)- Brand new stainless steel appliances- 5 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 3 dedicated parking spots. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: "Absolutely" is a beautiful Gulf-front home nestled in the charming community of Seagrove Beach on 30A. This luxury home offers all the amenities needed for a fantastic beach getaway, plus endless views of the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy the dazzling views of the pristine white beach and emerald waters while soaking up the sun in the incredible outdoor space next to the private, Gulf-front pool. "Absolutely" offers 5 bedrooms/ 5.5 bathrooms and spacious accommodations for 19 guests, including a media room and a second-floor patio, which makes a seamless transition of indoor/outdoor space, perfect for entertaining! Enjoy having your own private beach access as well as exploring the neighboring communities with the five bikes provided. Seagrove Beach is both laid back and luxurious, with many boutiques and casual dining options located down 30A. Check availability and book this 30A gulf front home today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 19):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With ShowerSECOND FLOOR: - Bunk Room: Two Queen over Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Three Twin Beds in Loft area*Unfortunately, the fire pit is not for guest use. *Please note: the rear balcony is not screened-in.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
